title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-019
description: Shaft outer diameter drifted positive toward and past USL (50.05 mm) during latter half of high-volume night shift batch. Machine telemetry showed tool cycle counter exceeded recommended threshold of 600 cycles, reaching 1,180 cycles before detection.
confirmed_root_cause: Progressive tool flank wear (VB > 0.35 mm) on carbide finish turning insert due to tool usage exceeding the scheduled preventive replacement threshold.
action_taken: Replaced indexable carbide insert with coated grade Kennametal CNMG432-RP. Recalibrated tool setter offset register Z and X. Updated SOP-044 to mandate tool change alarm at 650 cycles.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-024
description: Bearing housing bore measured immediately after roughing cut while part temperature was 48C. Part shrank 0.04 mm upon cooling to room temperature.
confirmed_root_cause: Failure to allow thermal stabilization prior to final inspection measurement.
action_taken: Enforced 15-minute thermal stabilization soaking station before final QC gauge pass.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-031
description: High-frequency circumferential ripples observed on shaft surface. Vibration sensor logged 4.2 mm/s radial vibration.
confirmed_root_cause: Loose clamping collet sleeve and worn tailstock live center bearing causing harmonic resonance.
action_taken: Replaced tailstock live center and adjusted hydraulic chuck pressure to 28 bar.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-042
description: First 10 parts of day shift produced at 50.08 mm consistently from part #1. No gradual drift; step-shift immediately following setup change.
confirmed_root_cause: Operator manually typed +0.035 mm instead of -0.035 mm into geometry wear offset register during morning changeover.
action_taken: Mandated barcode scanning for tool offset presets; locked manual CNC register editing.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-055
description: Front journal measured 50.01 mm but rear journal measured 50.07 mm across 180 mm span.
confirmed_root_cause: Headstock spindle axis out of parallel with Z-axis guideways by 0.045 mm over 300 mm test bar following minor turret bump.
action_taken: Re-aligned headstock spindle with precision dial indicator test mandrel.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-061
description: Axial scratch along finish ground journal found during visual inspection.
confirmed_root_cause: Hardened swarf chip adhered to urethane gripper finger on automated gantry parts catcher.
action_taken: Added compressed air blow-off nozzle to parts catcher gripper sequence.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-073
description: Sudden +0.03 mm diameter increase coinciding with new raw material bar bundle (Lot CS-8821).
confirmed_root_cause: Raw steel bundle hardness measured 245 HB instead of specified 190-210 HB, doubling cutting forces.
action_taken: Quarantined raw material lot CS-8821; filed supplier nonconformance with mill.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-084
description: Digital snap gauge G-08 recorded all batch parts at 50.06 mm, but master CMM re-measurement showed 50.01 mm.
confirmed_root_cause: Snap gauge calibration master anvil had loosened; zero point was offset +0.05 mm.
action_taken: Recalibrated snap gauge against Grade 0 ceramic gauge blocks and instituted 4-hour master zero checks.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-092
description: Tool insert failed after only 220 cycles with severe crater wear and burning.
confirmed_root_cause: Water-soluble coolant concentration dropped to 2.1% (nominal 8.0%), causing catastrophic lubricity loss.
action_taken: Installed automated refractometer coolant dosing unit on CNC-04 sump.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-103
description: Localized impact crater 1.2 mm wide on outer circumference.
confirmed_root_cause: Part exit chute padding had worn away, causing finished shaft to impact steel accumulator bin.
action_taken: Replaced chute lining with 10 mm high-density polyurethane cushion.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-140
description: Visual inspection flagged circumferential and longitudinal linear scratches along the bearing face of hexagonal flange metal nuts. Anomaly score 0.88, localized ROI on upper flange rim.
confirmed_root_cause: Hard carbide swarf embedded in the polyurethane lining of the automated unloader robot gripper fingers, creating repetitive scoring during part extraction.
action_taken: Replaced polyurethane gripper pads with hardened brass jaws, installed automated high-pressure air blow-off nozzle to clear swarf prior to grip, and updated daily maintenance checklist.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-141
description: Superficial scratches observed on outer hexagonal flats of metal nuts following gravity feed transition. Symptoms mimic unloader gripper abrasion.
confirmed_root_cause: Decoy investigation: Grippers inspected and verified clean. Root cause confirmed as excessive slope and lack of UHMW wear lining on the inter-stage gravity chute causing parts to tumble against sheet metal welds.
action_taken: Installed smooth UHMW polyethylene chute liners and reduced slide inclination from 35 degrees to 18 degrees to eliminate tumbling impact.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-142
description: Visual inspection identified localized edge dents and crater indentations on hexagonal flange corners. Average dent depth 0.25 mm exceeding visual aesthetic criteria.
confirmed_root_cause: Drop height from primary bulk hopper vibratory track to orientation spiral bowl was 450 mm without dampening baffle, causing metal-to-metal impact denting on case-hardened blanks.
action_taken: Installed stepped urethane cascade baffles to limit free-fall distance to < 80 mm and adjusted vibratory hopper feed rate sensor.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-143
description: Localized impact indentation observed on the copper mounting flange of TO-220 power transistor packages. Symptoms resemble hopper drop damage.
confirmed_root_cause: Decoy investigation: Bulk feeding chutes are foam-padded. Root cause confirmed as pneumatic parts-ejector cylinder air regulator failure, operating at 7.2 bar instead of specified 2.5 bar, driving parts against the metal catch bin.
action_taken: Replaced failed pressure regulator with lockable precision regulator set to 2.2 bar and added low-bounce silicone catch tray.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-144
description: Vision sensor detected inverted part orientation (flange facing downward rather than upward) entering the thread tapping spindle nest.
confirmed_root_cause: Optical orientation sensor reflector obscured by coolant mist deposits, failing to trigger the pneumatic rejection gate for upside-down parts.
action_taken: Installed positive air-purge curtain over orientation sensor optic lens and added secondary mechanical mechanical poke-yoke orientation keyway.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-145
description: Visual inspection identified swapped colored wire conductors (blue pin 3 and green pin 4 reversed) in 6-pin connector housing.
confirmed_root_cause: Wire harness assembly board routing guide peg for pin 3 was bent, leading assembly operator to misroute conductor into adjacent terminal guide slot.
action_taken: Replaced aluminum guide pegs with hardened steel keyed pins and implemented optical color-sequencing camera verification prior to connector latching.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-146
description: Visual inspection detected irregular brown and amber surface discoloration staining across bearing faces of machined metal nuts.
confirmed_root_cause: Part-washing station rinse nozzle clogged with calcium scale, leaving concentrated alkaline cleaning detergent residue that baked onto parts during hot-air drying.
action_taken: Descale wash and rinse manifolds, replace spray nozzles with quick-release stainless tips, and install automated pH rinse water conductivity monitor.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-147
description: Mottled yellowish discoloration on parts exiting preservation line. Visual appearance resembles alkaline rinse burn.
confirmed_root_cause: Decoy investigation: Washer nozzles confirmed clear and rinse pH normal (7.1). Root cause identified as rust preventive oil tank temperature controller exceeding 65C (setpoint: 40C), causing thermal oil oxidation.
action_taken: Replaced faulty RTD temperature thermocouple, flushed oil tank, and introduced dual-redundant thermal cut-off relay.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-148
description: Visual inspection identified flattened thread ridges and micro-tears along top 4 threads of M8 fastener screws. Pitch gauge indicated crest truncation.
confirmed_root_cause: Thread rolling die reached 82,000 cycles without scheduled regrind (limit: 75,000 cycles). Die profile wear caused insufficient penetration into blank root diameter.
action_taken: Replaced cylindrical rolling dies with matched Kennametal carbide set, re-calibrated center distance gauge, and set PLC cycle counter alarm to 70,000 cycles.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-149
description: Torn lead threads on screw tips following thread rolling. Die condition was suspected initially.
confirmed_root_cause: Decoy investigation: Thread rolling dies were new (< 5,000 cycles). Root cause traced upstream to CNC cold header blank cutting tool, which produced a 15-degree lead chamfer instead of the 45-degree specified chamfer.
action_taken: Re-ground header chamfer tooling insert to 45 degrees +/- 1 degree and added optical shadowgraph inspection at blanking station.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-150
description: Visual inspection flagged missing gate pin (pin 1) on TO-220 transistor package. Anomaly score 0.94; lead completely absent from terminal body.
confirmed_root_cause: Shear blade edge chipped on lead forming die station 1, causing excessive tensile fracture that tore the lead flush with the molded epoxy casing.
action_taken: Replaced shear blade punch assembly, reduced shear clearance to 0.02 mm, and added acoustic emission impact sensor to detect tooling notch chips.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-151
description: Visual camera detected only 3 insulated conductors entering breakout gland instead of required 4-conductor specification.
confirmed_root_cause: Upstream cable reel splice joint had broken conductor wire that went undetected during outer jacket extruding.
action_taken: Integrated high-frequency spark tester and magnetic inductive wire counter on jacket extrusion line.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-152
description: Visual inspection identified puncture marks and jacket tears exposing internal copper braiding on multi-conductor harness. Anomaly score 0.91.
confirmed_root_cause: Automatic stripping blade depth micrometer zero-shift error (+0.35 mm depth excess) penetrating both outer sheath and primary conductor dielectric.
action_taken: Calibrated stripping machine servo depth stop, implemented optical laser micrometer verification of stripped length and cut depth.

title: Nonconformance Report: NCR-153
description: Surface scoring along outer cable jacket resembling automated stripper blade nicking.
confirmed_root_cause: Decoy investigation: Stripping machines verified calibrated. Root cause determined to be metal chassis passthrough grommet missing its nylon split-sleeve collar, scraping harness during manual bundle pull.
action_taken: Installed captive snap-in protective nylon edge grommets on all assembly jigs and updated harness routing SOP.
